SMTO-PRX-0008 — More than one Proxmox server matches your request

GUID: e5a5af78-4e99-48f1-9bc4-357b82fc753f
Slug: proxmox-profile-ambiguous
Domain: PRX · Subsystem: prx

What happened

  • Your request could apply to more than one saved Proxmox server, so SMTO stopped instead of guessing which one you meant. Nothing was done on any Proxmox server.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Send the request again, mentioning with @ only the one Proxmox Server parameter you want to use. With exactly one Proxmox server named, SMTO knows where to act.
  2. If you need to work on several Proxmox servers, say clearly which server each action is for, using each parameter's exact name. SMTO acts on one Proxmox server at a time and won't choose between servers by itself.
  3. If this happens in a long conversation where you used several Proxmox servers, start a new conversation and mention just the one you want. SMTO remembers each Proxmox server used earlier in a conversation, so more than one can fit a request that doesn't name one.

What success looks like

  • The Agent's reply names the single Proxmox server you meant and shows the result.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't let SMTO pick a server for you; confirm the exact one before asking for any change.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Proxmox profile selection found more than one eligible accepted binding or verified Working Context server because server_ref was absent or did not narrow the candidates to one.

What this means

  • Profile selection finds more than one eligible candidate because the request does not uniquely select a server binding. Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.

Why this can happen

  • Profile selection finds more than one eligible candidate because the request does not uniquely select a server binding.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the returned candidate keys and choose the exact intended server_ref.

How to fix it

  • The ProxmoxError facts list the candidate parameter keys. Pass server_ref with the exact normalized key of the intended profile, or reference only one Proxmox @parameter; for Working Context candidates, make sure only the intended server is verified on this Gateway. Do not silently switch a saved run to a different server.
  • Select the exact configured server profile from current discovery.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Exactly one accepted profile matches the intended server and Gateway.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
